translations.web: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
translations.bsb: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
translations.kjv: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth
translations.asv: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
